status: Candidate comparison, not adopted focus; selective searches, no reproduction

sources.citation: Kapteyn, M. G., & Willcox, K. E. (2022). Design of Digital Twin Sensing Strategies Via Predictive Modeling and Interpretable Machine Learning. Journal of Mechanical Design, 144(9), 091710.
sources.status_version: Published journal article; 21-page author manuscript read; no revision identifier on inspected copy
sources.reading_depth: Deep selected: sections II-III pp.2-8, IV data and results pp.11-18; conclusion pp.17-19. Web PDF text. Screenshot attempted; no inspected local render.
sources.method: Reduced-order physics models synthesize observations; optimal classification trees map sensors to discretized structural states and select sensor subsets.
sources.evaluation: UAV structural example; 2500 synthetic noisy data points; tree depth/split complexity and fixed versus selectable sensors compared. Physical deployment is future work in conclusion.
sources.artifacts_access: Public author PDF; code/data availability not verified. Commercial optimization tooling discussed.
sources.limitations: Known fixed state space; synthetic Gaussian noise; state classification objective does not establish intervention-regret improvement.
sources.candidate_relevance: Blocks broad novelty claim for digital-twin adaptive sensing; differentiated decision loss and unknown topology would require evidence.

sources.citation: Klunder, G. A., Taale, H., Kester, L., & Hoogendoorn, S. (2014). The effect of inaccurate traffic data for ramp metering: Comparing loop detectors and cameras using information utility. IFAC Proceedings Volumes, pp.11318-11325.
sources.status_version: Published IFAC conference paper; eight-page manuscript; DOI not verified
sources.reading_depth: Deep selected: sections 4.2-5.2 pp.4-6, cost analysis p.7; PDF text. Screenshot cache failure.
sources.method: Vissim A10 West with modified ALINEA; perturb flow/speed measurements, derive utility and camera/loop cost comparison.
sources.evaluation: Illustrative visually calibrated motorway; average network speed, random/systematic error, same-seed runs.
sources.artifacts_access: Public PDF and TNO record; executable/data archive not verified.
sources.limitations: Illustrative calibration and assumed sensor costs; not a field causal evaluation or joint map/demand ambiguity study.
sources.candidate_relevance: Direct prior art for data accuracy-to-decision utility; simply adding traffic sensing to VoI is insufficient novelty.

sources.citation: Malings, C., & Pozzi, M. (2019). Submodularity issues in value-of-information-based sensor placement. Reliability Engineering & System Safety, 183, 93-103.
sources.status_version: Published journal article; publisher abstract/introduction and section snippets
sources.reading_depth: Targeted publisher text; full numerical methods not inspected
sources.method: Examine greedy sensor selection under non-submodular value of information; heuristic alternatives.
sources.evaluation: Counterexamples/application cases described; no numeric claim extracted.
sources.limitations: Cannot transfer optimality guarantees to a new highway acquisition policy.
sources.candidate_relevance: Explicit reason to test complementarity of map inspections and traffic measurements.

sources.citation: Gomes, G., Gan, Q., & Bayen, A. (2018). A methodology for evaluating the performance of model-based traffic prediction systems. Transportation Research Part C, 96, 160-169.
sources.status_version: Published journal article; typeset ten-page author-hosted copy; DOI verified on p.160
sources.reading_depth: Deep selected: sections 3-4 pp.163-166, sections 5-6 pp.166-168; PDF text. Screenshot cache failure.
sources.method: Paired test of model-based versus model-less prediction, day-level statistical units; data-quality-adaptive reference.
sources.evaluation: I-210 Eastbound, 35 manually selected days, CTM with two demand/split predictors; full and degraded sensor conditions. Flow errors favor only one model-based system.
sources.artifacts_access: Public PDF; PeMS and BeATS described, exact experiment archive unchecked.
sources.limitations: Predictive error comparison does not observe counterfactual intervention outcomes. Selected days and historical-profile construction require care when designing stronger held-out tests.
sources.candidate_relevance: Direct Southern California prior art: realistic corridor plus calibration test is already established.

sources.citation: Azevedo, C. L., Ciuffo, B., Cardoso, J. L., & Ben-Akiva, M. E. (2015). Dealing with uncertainty in detailed calibration of traffic simulation models for safety assessment. Transportation Research Part C, 58(B), 395-412.
sources.status_version: Published journal article; author preprint indexed; direct PDF open failed
sources.reading_depth: Indexed author-manuscript abstract and section 2.2 p.6; not full methods/evaluation
sources.method: Multistep global sensitivity/calibration across input, model, method and output uncertainty; trajectory and aggregate data.
sources.evaluation: Urban motorway, more than 100 parameters, accident/non-accident calibrations; reported abstract only.
sources.artifacts_access: Indexed public manuscript; executable archive unchecked
sources.limitations: Insufficient reading depth for numerical comparison; revisit if benchmark focus approved.
sources.candidate_relevance: Blocks a claim that studying several interacting traffic uncertainties is itself new.

sources.citation: Schrader, M., & Bittle, J. (2024). A Global Sensitivity Analysis of Traffic Microsimulation Input Parameters on Performance Metrics. IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems. DOI 10.1109/TITS.2024.3372334.
sources.status_version: Published journal article; author repository citation verified, final pagination not verified from primary record
sources.reading_depth: Author repository README and file inventory; paper full text not read
sources.method: SUMO sensitivity analysis, parameter distributions, parallel execution and analysis notebooks.
sources.evaluation: Repository provides SA1/SA2 configuration and result processing; no independent performance claim extracted.
sources.artifacts_access: Public MIT-licensed repository; not cloned or executed; pinned commit not established

sources.citation: Punzo, V., Iannelli, D., Saltelli, A., & Montanino, M. (2026). How do human factors affect the explanatory power of driver models? A methodology for comparative model assessment and validation. Transportation Research Part B, 211, 103466.
sources.status_version: Published September 2026 journal issue; institution lists open publisher PDF
sources.reading_depth: Publisher abstract, introduction 1.1-1.2, contribution statements and conclusion snippets; not complete methods/results
sources.method: Trajectory-level paired calibration, normalized relative errors, sensitivity analysis and full-factorial human-factor variants.
sources.evaluation: Reported 800 IDM-family variants and three naturalistic datasets; no independent result verification.
sources.artifacts_access: Publisher points to https://github.com/i4Driving; exact corresponding release/license not checked
sources.limitations: Comparing driver models is not evaluating intervention ranking under joint map/observation errors; scope distinction needs deeper reading.
sources.candidate_relevance: Recent close frontier; invalidates generic novelty based on model-ranking instability or complexity/accuracy tradeoffs.

sources.citation: Spitkovska, V., & Kuzmenko, D. (2026). Trajectory Design and Budgeted Querying for Digital Twin Calibration. arXiv:2608.08631v1.
sources.status_version: 9 August 2026 v1 preprint; arXiv comments report CDEL ECCV 2026 non-archival workshop acceptance; venue acceptance not independently checked
sources.reading_depth: Deep HTML sections 3.1-3.4, 4.1-4.2 and Table 1; section 4.3 and limitations not fully inspected
sources.method: PPO excitation, GRU predictive Gaussian and frozen-estimator budgeted query policy. Query returns privileged true parameter for one step, does not update estimator.
sources.evaluation: Pendulum and Waterworld; query policy only in Pendulum; single training run, 20 Pendulum evaluation episodes; no significance tests.
sources.artifacts_access: Public CC BY 4.0 HTML; implementation availability not verified
sources.limitations: Exploratory unmatched comparisons; no same-protocol query-free ablation for oracle-withdrawal case. No formal identifiability result; no traffic validation.
sources.candidate_relevance: Budgeted twin calibration querying is existing work; possible difference is noisy heterogeneous acquisitions updating persistent belief and minimizing intervention regret, requiring matched ablations.
